caption: The drawing depicts a rural landscape showing a river that winds through gently rolling, yellow-brown hills under a cloudy blue sky. In the foreground, a wooden structure, possibly a partially built bridge, extends over the river. Several people are grouped together on the end of this structure, facing inward, with their backs to the viewer; they are mostly dressed in dark brown and blue clothing and hats. At the center of the structure rises a tall wooden framework composed of vertical beams with ropes attached. On the right side of the image, there is an enclosed area fenced with wooden rails, containing a small brown and gray building with a chimney, next to which sits an orange-colored object. There are several white and gray animals, apparently sheep, within the enclosure. Behind the enclosure, there are clusters of trees with yellow, orange, and green foliage. The background consists of more rolling fields and distant wooded areas. The overall color palette of the drawing leans towards earthy yellows, greens, light browns, and blues.
title: Women Operating the Pile Driver
